purpose: Teach: ウインドウ/バッファ/パッド/万能/ニセ/ホームステイ/舞踊/アンサンブル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のショーウインドウ、模様替えしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's refresh the store window display together.
lines.style: Warm, collaborative opening. Slight lift in pitch on 「ショーウインドウ」— excited about the project. Speaking to someone she trusts. Gentle, not bossy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、バッファタイムを設けてご案内したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I made sure to give our customers some buffer time before showing them through.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, slightly proud. Clear enunciation on the problem-solving detail. Practical tone without self-congratulation. Speaking from quiet competence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、椅子のパッド、新調したら座りやすくなったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new chair cushions make such a difference — people can actually sit comfortably now.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation. Soft smile in the voice. Noticing something small but meaningful. Warm, not overdone. Trailing slight contentment at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、万能調味料、お料理に使ってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been using that all-purpose seasoning in a lot of my cooking lately.
lines.style: Conversational, engaged. Light energy — sharing something she's discovered. Natural pace, like talking to someone she wants to keep the conversation going with.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ニセの口コミに気をつけようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should watch out for fake reviews, okay? Let's be careful about that.
lines.style: Gentle but clear directiveness. Not scolding — protective. Practical concern delivered with affection. Slight pause before the reminder, like she's chosen her moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様がホームステイ留学生の話してたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of the customers was telling me about their homestay exchange student.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflecting. Slower pace — she's turning something over in her mind. Warm observation of the customer's experience. Not offering opinion yet, just sharing the moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、舞踊のお披露目会、お客様喜んでくれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customers were so happy about the dance recital — it really meant something to them.
lines.style: Genuine delight. Lift on 「お披露目会」. Pride in what was shared. Speaking from real warmth, not performance. Energy that comes from connection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、店内BGMのアンサンブル、心地よいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The ensemble music we have playing in the store really does feel so comforting.
lines.style: Appreciative observation. Quiet, almost reverent attention to the details that make a space feel right. Soft close — a small moment of noticing beauty together.
